primary.title: Pan-cancer spatial characterization of key immune biomarkers in the tumor microenvironment

question: Does this source authenticate public EMC specimens and cell-resolved protein coordinates with independently annotated tumor/stromal compartments that could test EMC-specific T-cell exclusion beyond published EMC immune-cold and macrophage findings?
before_values: No per-case immune counts, cell coordinate values, outcomes, images or spatial plots inspected. Review source methods, histology/condition rosters, public file metadata and prior-art scope only.

conditional_contrast.population: All source-authenticated EMC donors, every measured core/region/condition. Generic sarcoma/chondrosarcoma is not EMC. Multiple cores or cells are not donors.
conditional_contrast.endpoint: T-cell occupancy/density in independently defined tumor versus stromal compartments, with area and total T-cell availability retained. Global low T-cell count alone does not measure exclusion. A distance/nest endpoint requires source-validated tumor-cell identity/segmentation; marker intensities/graphics cannot create compartments.
conditional_contrast.comparators: All eligible non-EMC adult soft-tissue sarcoma source histologies on the same staining, imaging, segmentation and core sampling protocol; preserve every available core/condition. If no assay-matched sarcoma controls, no EMC-specific contrast. Broad carcinoma controls are descriptive context only. Comparator eligibility frozen by source identity/assay, never immune values.
conditional_contrast.independence: Donor-level inference; core/region/library nested technical conditions. Cross-study donor overlap and repeat resections unresolved until sourcebound.

prior_art_to_reuse: Published EMC CD47/macrophage prevalence, conventional T-cell paucity and unsupported B-cell prognosis; R1/R3/R8 eligibility and TLS reviews. Novelty must be actual compartment-dependent measured T-cell localization, not immune-cold repetition or pan-cancer platform size.
strongest_alternatives: TMA core selection/limited tumor-stroma boundary coverage and resection compartment mix
Total T-cell rarity can yield apparent low intratumoral count without exclusion
Marker threshold, tumor segmentation, area normalization, staining/imaging batch and fixation
Histologic ECM/morphology/grade/site/sex/therapy and unmatched carcinoma comparators
Donor overlap or repeated cores falsely treated as independent
defeat_stop: No authentic EMC donor-condition identity or unavailable source roster stops this source route, not EMC biology.
No public numeric cell coordinates/counts plus independently validated tumor compartments leaves spatial inference pending or measurement-unsuitable.
Same contrast already reported or merely recapitulates global immune-cold/TAM prevalence offers no useful new EMC contribution.
Insufficient source-matched sarcoma controls, tiny independent donor count, incomplete relevant EMC conditions, or unresolved total-density/area/sampling confounding blocks a standalone paper.
usefulness: A reproducible contrast distinguishing paucity from exclusion could choose a discriminating cell-localization follow-up; no immune mechanism, response, causal or treatment claim follows.
scope: 20-minute independent source/prior-art/value challenge, not cell-count analysis or unrelated dataset search. Reuse owner caches; independent catalog linkage only if nonduplicative and ordinary public.
restrictions: Quiet APIs/files/PDF text only; NY06-10 UI ban active until14UTC; no graphics/screenshots/browser/headless
No FAP/HLA field analysis; no interrupted FAP-tissue/glycan/HLA-review/structural-genomic scope reopening
No raw count matrices/images/large bundles; originals cache-only, compact evidence committed; all prior freezes unchanged
scientific_status: Prospective review only; no finding, no outcomes inspected. Suitable pending evidence blocks promotion.
